listing.name: Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks (Xbox) (ShaolinMonksRecomp)
listing.summary: Attach an independently permitted, prepared OpenShao Windows player using the supported USA/Europe Xbox original. Preserve the separate application-data and Saved Games locations, remembered source and legacy-folder migration recovery.

steps.title: Prepare the supported original upstream
steps.instruction: Use a complete player and components you are independently permitted to use, with your own USA/Europe Xbox Mortal Kombat: Shaolin Monks, title 4D570029. The selected profile identifies entry 000F40CA and XDK 5849. The runtime compares default.xbe SHA1 against the exact original used when that player was built; CMake generates that constant from the build input. Its actual release-input SHA1 is not published in the reviewed profile, so an exact independently established release digest remains Unknown. Do not replace this check with a title-name assumption or mismatch bypass. Finish upstream game selection/validation before attachment.

steps.title: Keep the complete Windows package
steps.instruction: The inspected official 0.4.1 Windows x64 ZIP contains AMD64 OpenShao.exe and matching resources/notices. Upstream accepts ISO/XISO or complete extracted folders in place; ZIP import is a separate upstream preparation operation. Keep the selected source at its remembered location. Windows requirements include Windows 10 1903+, SSE4.2/POPCNT and supported Direct3D 12 or Vulkan graphics. No original, archive importer, compiler, helper or game is obtained or executed by this guide.

steps.title: Attach the remembered-source player
steps.instruction: After setup, select OpenShao.exe, set the complete extracted package directory as working directory and use the documented --no-launcher argument. Review the intent and request Play separately. The host uses its remembered game-source.toml selection and the linked game; finish any missing/invalid-source prompt, update, mod installation or restart upstream before retrying. Mortal Kombat II and The Suffering demo are explicitly unsupported; this guide does not admit them.

steps.title: Preserve data, saves and old folder selections
steps.instruction: Normally keep %LOCALAPPDATA%/OpenShao for settings.toml, game-source.toml, paths.toml, logs, cache, crashes, reports and mods, and the actual Windows Saved Games/OpenShao directory for saves. Known folders may be relocated. The Files page can move data and saves independently; an existing --data-dir, --save-dir or --portable-saves changes the layout. Preserve every actual root, locator, original and older named folder before the first 0.3+ startup: upstream can move eligible legacy data/saves and rewrite their paths. This guide performs no migration, restore, backup or deletion.

steps.title: Keep maintenance and permissions separate
steps.instruction: Retain the GPL-2.0-or-later project notice, exact XboxXBERecomp MIT and all SDL, font, renderer, Lua and other component notices. They do not license original game recordings, discs or separate Portuguese/mod packages. The upstream launcher owns update/download/restart and optional content. Quit normally, preserve independent recovery copies and review/relink changed executable bytes after replacement. Source/archive checks are not native, campaign, co-op, save/reload, installed-app or Supported acceptance. Removing registration preserves external files; managed lifecycle operations remain unavailable.

warnings: The exact release-input XBE SHA1 remains Unknown. Keep both data and Saved Games roots plus legacy recovery; unsupported bundled demos are not admitted.
